periods.analysis: Our energy saving implementations have been successfully reducing the cost of electiricy and water usage in municipal facilities.
periods.recommendations: We should continue to increase the number of facilities incorporating energy efficient upgrades. Over the next few months we should consider instating a green initatives committee to suggest improvements to facilities.

periods.analysis: We have stalled in our efforts to get municipal facilities to incorporate energy-efficient upgrades, so we need to do more to reach our target.
periods.recommendations: We should prepare a report showing the cost savings associated with energy-efficient upgrades so that leadership makes them a priority and we reach our target.
